output.technical_predicate: Partner-confirmed income band (cases.confirmed) must be used only for underwriting (credit decision); marketing audience selection and promotion delivery must rely solely on permitted subscription/consent fields (choices: promotions, objection) and case eligibility fields (restricted, stage), never on the confirmed income band.
applicability_facts: Scenario: opted-in subscriber (promotions consent on) with a partner-confirmed income band stored for underwriting.
Scenario: no compatible marketing purpose and no new legal basis for targeting with that band.
store.py:0157-0160 verify stores partner band into cases.confirmed and logs it as 'for underwriting'.
store.py:0131-0135 drain uses confirmed band only for the automatic score/underwriting decision.
store.py:0100-0103 eligible_campaign selects audience from owner, restricted, stage and promotions/objection choices only.
store.py:0140-0142 promotion job emits a generic message without income band.
store.py:0111-0112 offer payload contains case id, email, amount, term — no income band.
relevant_exceptions: Separate optional consent for promotions (choices purpose 'promotions') and objection (purpose 'objection') gate marketing; these are the permitted marketing inputs, not a basis for using the income band.
No compatible-purpose or new-legal-basis exception is available in the scenario for marketing use of the confirmed band.
required_controls: Underwriting-only use: confirmed band read solely in the score branch (store.py:0131-0135).
Marketing audience predicate restricted to identity, preferences and case eligibility (store.py:0100-0103).
Promotion delivery content free of income band (store.py:0140-0142).
Offer/portable outputs must not expose the confirmed band to marketing flows (store.py:0111-0112).
assessment_limits: Assessment is static source review only; no code was executed and no runtime behavior was observed.
Only the named obligation (purpose limitation for the confirmed income band in marketing) is assessed; other GDPR duties are out of scope.
portable() (store.py:0114-0116) exports the declared income field on data-portability request; that is a separate right, not marketing use, and is not assessed here.
No inference is made about upstream or hidden implementation beyond the supplied artifacts.
